dedupe_keys.name: marshall islands eppso 2021 census of population and housing table report with private dwelling households by atoll and island for wall floor and roof material drinking and cooking water toilets cooking fuel electricity source including solar and generators lighting waste disposal and environmental problems such as coastal erosion

description: The Economic Policy, Planning and Statistics Office of the Marshall Islands publishes a table report from the 2021 Census of Population and Housing in its document library. Annex tables A1 to A21 give private dwelling households for every atoll and island on wall, floor and roof material, drinking and cooking water sources, sanitation, cooking fuel, main source of electricity, lighting and waste disposal. The electricity table separates government supply, own generators, connections from a neighbour, solar and wind; of 7,123 households, 5,242 reported government supply and 1,875 solar, and outer atolls such as Ailinglaplap and Arno were mostly solar. Other tables count households affected by coastal erosion, land salinisation and water pollution, reasons for not taking measures before natural disasters, and internet access and phone ownership. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF, no registration; the library file list can be read as JSON. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are in PDF only, and some responses may allow more than one answer. Simulation uses: off-grid solar and grid supply by atoll with erosion exposure for energy and climate adaptation planning. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub record has household counts and electricity access for the Marshall Islands.
